title: QR Code Poster
scenario: A poster near school says scan to vote for lunch menu, then asks for login credentials.

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.C: Report/block it and do not share private details.
answers.D: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.

explanation: QR Code Poster: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Public QR codes can be replaced; verify before entering credentials.
